verdict.rationale: A single vendor-doc entry claims Obsidian Sync offers a 'headless client' explicitly for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows, which is directly on-topic for this story. However, this is the only mention anywhere in the evidence pack — no other docs, GitHub references, or community/hands-on reports corroborate a headless mode, CLI, or automation-friendly execution of the app itself. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of headless sync, documentation of a CLI/automation API for the main app, and any community evidence of using Obsidian in CI/agent pipelines.
